name: article-title-summarizer
description: Creates coherent summary paragraphs from lists of article titles. Use when the user provides multiple article titles and requests a summary, overview paragraph, or narrative synthesis of the content themes. Ideal for literature reviews, content aggregation, research summaries, or generating descriptive text from reading lists.
author: JJ Halans
triggers: write a paragraph about these titles
turn these titles into a paragraph

usage.prompt: Given a list of article titles, identify recurring themes and produce a single neutral, present-tense paragraph (3–6 sentences) that synthesizes the dominant topics. Prepend YAML frontmatter containing a kebab-case `tags` list derived from the identified themes.

titles.description: A list of article titles to synthesize into a summary paragraph.

markdown.description: A markdown string with YAML frontmatter (tags list) followed by a single summary paragraph.
